CREATE TABLE admins (
	chat_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(255), 
	full_name VARCHAR(255), 
	role VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(255), 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE branch_pricing (
	min_branches INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_branches INTEGER, 
	price_per_branch FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN, 
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE branches (
	restaurant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR(20), 
	wilaya VARCHAR(100), 
	lat FLOAT, 
	lng FLOAT, 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE categories (
	restaurant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER, 
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE feature_pricing (
	feature_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	billing_cycle VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	price FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN, 
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE feature_usage_counters (
	restaurant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	feature_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	usage_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	period_year INTEGER, 
	period_month INTEGER, 
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE feature_usage_limits (
	plan_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	feature_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	monthly_limit INTEGER, 
	limit_type VARCHAR(50), 
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE features (
	code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (code)
)

CREATE TABLE loyalty_discounts (
	years_required INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	discount_percent FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE multi_restaurant_discounts (
	min_restaurants INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	discount_percent FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE option_groups (
	product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	required BOOLEAN, 
	multiple_choice BOOLEAN, 
	sort_order INTEGER, 
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE order_item_options (
	order_item_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	option_group_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	option_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	additional_price FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)

	product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
